answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: full rewards need work with 12 distinct counterparties over three terraces. Each agent posts a 25-credit bond, hard as basalt, refunded. A sybil ring trading with its copies fails, since fake-to-fake deals do not count. Forging 100 identities locks 2500 credits and needs 1200 partners at 50 credits each, above any reward. An honest agent pays 25 once, reaches the haven of full rates, and keeps reward undiluted.
